items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Well I was in my group and Norman Blaze, which some of you jazz people never heard of I don't think, Eulett Jones, Herbert Jones, and Ryber Jones.

ctx.x: Sure, I had a group there too. Who was in your group at that time? Well I was in my group and Norman Blaze, which some of you jazz people never heard of I don't think, Eulett Jones, Herbert Jones, and Ryber Jones. Those boys there played on Boynton Street in their life.
